About

A firm built around the month, not the emergency.

SP Nexus exists for businesses that need reliable operational and administrative support — whether they are establishing, growing or refining how the work gets done.

Who we work with

Businesses across different stages and markets that need practical support covering administration, documentation, operations, strategy, customer experience, performance tracking, specialist interventions, Business Revival, events, property and logistics.

We work with organisations looking to establish, operate, improve or expand within South Africa and across Africa.

SP Nexus (Pty) Ltd is a registered South African company based in Pretoria, Gauteng. We do not claim volumes or turnaround times we cannot stand behind. The work is the package.

Mission

To give each client a clear monthly view of administration, documents, finances where included, and priorities — and the capacity to act on it.

Founder & Leadership

Meet Our Founder

Mbali Tshabalala

Founder & CEO

SP Nexus (Pty) Ltd was founded by Mbali Tshabalala with a vision to help businesses access practical, reliable support that strengthens their operations and supports sustainable growth.

As Founder and Chief Executive Officer, Mbali leads the company’s vision, strategy, service development and overall direction.

Through SP Nexus, she is building a business focused on practical business solutions, operations, administration, bookkeeping and tailored support that helps businesses manage their responsibilities, improve their systems and pursue new opportunities.

Her vision is to make valuable business support more accessible, practical and aligned with each client’s needs.

Business Revival

Structured support when the business needs to regain clarity and momentum.

For businesses experiencing operational disorder, stagnation, weak systems, administrative gaps or a need to rebuild how the work runs. We do not promise guaranteed growth or financial recovery — we provide practical, structured work.

Choose the level of structure your business needs. Scope is agreed in writing before work starts. We do not guarantee revenue growth or financial turnaround.

Business Revival

R7,000

A focused engagement to map what is not working and put a clearer operating baseline in place.

What is included

  • Working session to understand current operations and pain points
  • Gap map across administration, processes and priorities
  • Written summary of findings and recommended next steps
  • A practical action list the owner can follow
  • One follow-up check-in within the agreed period

Best for businesses that need clarity before committing to ongoing support.

Revival Intensive

R15,000

Deeper, hands-on support across several operational areas so the business can run with more order and less owner overload.

What is included

  • Everything in Business Revival, with expanded depth
  • Structured review of core processes and documentation gaps
  • Setup or tidy-up of priority administrative systems
  • Agreed document and process templates where useful
  • Priority action plan with owners and timeframes
  • Guided implementation support over the engagement period
  • Progress check-ins and a closing handover summary

Best when systems are weak in more than one area and the owner needs active help, not only advice.

Complex / Custom

From R15,000

For multi-branch, multi-team or highly disordered operations where a standard package is not enough. Scope and price are set after assessment.

What is included

  • Revival assessment of complexity, capacity and risk areas
  • Custom scope across the functions that need rebuilding
  • Coordinated work plan with clear deliverables and milestones
  • Documentation, process design and operational coordination as agreed
  • Optional handover into a monthly Core, Elevate or Bespoke package

Final fee depends on size, number of sites, urgency and the work agreed in writing.

Logistics

SP Nexus Logistics

Business-facing logistics coordination and transport solutions — the movement of goods, distribution, supplier and transport-partner coordination, and delivery operations according to the agreed scope and available partners.

SP Nexus does not own a fleet, employ all drivers directly, or operate warehouses. Availability, route, price, timing, size and handling requirements are confirmed for each enquiry. We do not guarantee delivery times unless agreed in writing for that job.

Logistics coordination (business)

Transport & goods movement

Coordinating the movement of business stock, product and goods.

Distribution & delivery

Distribution and delivery coordination with suitable partners.

Supplier & partner coordination

Working with transport partners and suppliers on your requirement.

Once-off or recurring

Ad hoc jobs or ongoing logistics arrangements where partners are available.

Larger / commercial loads

Larger-item and commercial delivery coordination where suitable partners exist.

Courier & parcel delivery (separate service)

Courier is a parcel-focused service (collection, transport and delivery to the recipient). It is related to logistics but not the same as the full Logistics coordination division above.

Referrals

Introduce someone to SP Nexus.

If you know a business that needs practical operations, administration or specialist support, share their details. We will only contact them about SP Nexus services and will not mass-message anyone.

Referral discount (existing clients)
When you are an existing SP Nexus client and the business you refer newly registers with SP Nexus, you may receive a 5% discount on your eligible monthly service fee for the qualifying month only (after verification). It is not a permanent discount. Sharing a name alone does not qualify — registration is required. Terms are confirmed by SP Nexus before any discount is applied.

By submitting, you confirm you have a reasonable basis to introduce this business and that SP Nexus may contact them once about relevant services.

Prefer a quick share? Send them spnexus.co.za or WhatsApp us on 066 360 2429.

Privacy

How SP Nexus handles information you share with us.

SP Nexus (Pty) Ltd (“we”, “us”) respects your privacy. This notice explains what we collect and why.

Information we collect

When you contact us, book a consultation, or use the Business Health Check, you may provide your name, business name, email, phone number and related business details. We use this to respond to you and deliver services you request.

How we use it

We use your information to communicate with you, provide quotations and services, and improve our offerings. We do not sell your personal information.

Storage and security

This public website does not operate a secure client database in the browser. Information submitted through public forms on this static site is not automatically stored on our servers unless a connected form backend is in place. Prefer emailing hello@spnexus.co.za for confidential matters.

Your rights

You may request access to or correction of personal information we hold about you, subject to applicable South African law including the Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA) where it applies. Contact us at the email above.
